name: Draconic Resilience (Dragonsired)
body:
You possess a small fraction of the awe-inspiring resilience of your draconic forebears.

Prerequisites: Dragonsired racial trait, lizardfolk.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against sleep and paralysis effects, and you may reroll one saving throw against such an effect each day after determining if your original roll failed or succeeded. Your dragonsired energy resistance increases to 1 per Hit Die up to a maximum of 10.
